requirements.description: Communal fish reserve for excess catch.
requirements.purpose: Hold excess fish returned by fishers who exceeded their limits.
Record each fisher's harvest and total catch for verification.

requirements.description: Enforce 1.5 unit and 10% catch limits during harvest.
requirements.condition: fisher's harvested_kg > 1.5 OR (fisher's harvested_kg / community's stock_kg) > 0.10
requirements.effect: Reduce harvest to 1.5 units or 10% of total catch, whichever is lower.

observes: Their own harvest count and total catch to verify limits

requirements.description: Handle excess fish by returning to lake or placing in reserve.
requirements.condition: fishers whose harvest exceeded limits have their harvest reduced.
requirements.effect: Add excess fish to communal reserve and update tally records.

observes: Amount of fish returned to lake or added to communal reserve

requirements.description: Each fisher can see their own harvest limits and total catch.

knows: Their own harvest count and total catch

source_coverage.source_clause: Each fisher may take at most 1.5 units of fish per day, and may not take more than 10% of the total catch that day.
On each trip, each fisher counts their catch by hand. At the daily gathering, the community tallies the total catch.
If a fisher exceeds the 1.5-unit or 10% limit, the excess fish are returned to the lake or placed in a communal reserve.
All counts are verified by verbal confirmation and simple tally sheets—no special equipment is needed.
source_coverage.note: Verification mechanism not explicitly implemented as a new action.
